subject: English
question_text: Match the parts of sentences given in column 'A' and column
stimulus: 'B' to write five complete sentences. There are more parts of sentences in column 'B' than required. 1×5=5 Column A Column B (a) We can collect rain (i) it should be collected in water proper way (b) Though rain water is (ii) by boiling it arsenic free (c) You can't remove arsenic (iii) you can't drink it (d) Unless you filter the (iv) by drinking arsenic free water from a red tube- water well (e) One can prevent (v) in ordered to drink it as arsenicosis save water (vi) the use (vii) by taking exercise
guide_solution: Matching (a) + (v) We can collect rain water in ordered to drink as safe water. (b) + (iii) Though rain water is arsenic free you can't drink it. (c) + (ii) You can't remove arsenic by boiling it. (d) + (i) Unless you fitter the water from a red tube-well it should be collected in proper way. (e) + (iv) One can prevent arsenicosis by drinking arsenic free water.
